content_blocks.label: clause_1._DEFINITION_OF_CONFIDENTIAL_INFORMATION
content_blocks.text: ‘CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION’ means any information disclosed by the Disclosing Party to the Receiving Party.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_OBLIGATIONS
content_blocks.text: The Receiving Party shall maintain the confidentiality of the CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION and shall not disclose it to any third party without the written consent of the Disclosing Party.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._TERM
content_blocks.text: This Agreement shall remain in effect until the expiration of ten (10) years from the effective date hereof.

content_blocks.label: notary_note
content_blocks.text: Sworn before me this 10th day of July 2024.
